# LLMCSS Specification & Rules for AI Agents (llms-full.txt)
*A Human-Craft Design Operating System for Autonomous AI Coding Agents*

LLMCSS is an open, pure-CSS UI framework engineered to eliminate generic AI design slop and empower autonomous AI coding agents and human developers to build distinctive, high-craft interfaces.

---

## 1. The 11 Non-Negotiable Anti-Slop Laws

Every AI coding agent generating interfaces with LLMCSS must strictly comply with these ten laws:

### Law 1: Never Nest Containers (Eliminate "Cardocalypse")
Do not place a bordered card inside another bordered card (`.ai-card` inside `.ai-card`). Nested boxes create visual clutter and waste screen real estate.
- Instead: Use generous whitespace (`--ai-space-6`), subtle hairline rules (`<hr class="ai-divider">`), or distinct background shifts (`var(--ai-surface-1)`).

### Law 2: Never Pulse Static Status Pips
Never attach continuous breathing or pulsing animations (`@keyframes pulse`) to steady states like "System Normal", "Online", or "Completed". Flashing indicators demand attention when nothing has changed.
- Instead: Render a calm, static jewel pip with `.ai-status-pip` and `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(...)`. Reserve `.ai-status-pip.is-streaming` strictly for ongoing inference or active data transmission.

### Law 3: Never Use Colored Left-Stripe Borders (Side-Tab Cards)
Do not place thick 3px to 5px colored vertical stripes on the left edge of cards, toasts, or dialogs. This 2012-era alert pattern makes every element scream for attention.
- Instead: Use a 1px uniform architectural border (`border: 1px solid var(--ai-border)`), accompanied by a subtle 6px status jewel pip or an inline icon.

### Law 4: Never Use Electric Purple/Cyan Halos or Radial Glows
Avoid murky dark backgrounds flooded with saturated purple-to-blue gradients or zero-offset neon drop shadows.
- Instead: Build depth using multi-stop physical elevation with slight vertical offset:
  `box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05), 0 8px 16px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);`

### Law 5: Never Stamp Formulaic Eyebrows Above Headlines
Avoid adding an uppercase monospace overline (`01 // FEATURES` or `OVERVIEW`) above every heading. When repeated everywhere, eyebrows become visual noise that delays reading the headline.
- Instead: Lead directly with a confident, well-typeset headline (`h1` or `h2`). If context is needed, fold it into the heading or supporting sentence.

### Law 6: Never Crush Letter-Spacing Below -0.04em or Justify Body Text
Do not apply extreme negative letter-spacing that makes characters collide, and never use `text-align: justify` which causes distracting typographic rivers.
- Instead: Keep body text at tracking `0` with `line-height: 1.6`. Restrict negative tracking to large display headings (`-0.02em` to `-0.035em`).

### Law 7: Never Place Low-Contrast Gray Text on Colored Backgrounds
Never render neutral `#71717a` gray text over an accent surface or tinted banner.
- Instead: Ensure WCAG AA compliance (minimum 4.5:1 for body copy, 3:1 for large display). When the background is tinted, tint the secondary text from the same hue.

### Law 8: Never Create Flat, Identical Metric Grids
Do not display 4 identical KPI cards with identical weights and icons.
- Instead: Establish clear hierarchy. Make the primary metric anchor dominant in size (`font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 700;`), with supporting secondary metrics grouped in tighter rows or tables below.

### Law 9: Never Auto-Scroll Copy (Marquees)
Do not force readers to wait for auto-scrolling tickers or animated marquee loops to read supported integrations or technologies.
- Instead: Render a clean, static, responsive badge rail (`.ai-badge-neutral`) or a balanced grid that users can scan at their own speed.

### Law 10: Always Theme Native Browser Surfaces
An interface is incomplete if native browser affordances revert to un-themed system defaults.
- Always Verify: Text selection (`::selection`), caret color (`caret-color: var(--ai-accent)`), custom scrollbars (`scrollbar-color`), link underline offset (`text-underline-offset: 0.2em`), and tabular numerals (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`).

### Law 11: Never Use Square Grid Backgrounds (AI Graph Paper / Blueprint Patterns)
Avoid covering backgrounds in repeating 20px-40px square grid lines, dot grids, or mesh graph paper patterns via intersecting linear-gradient declarations. This is one of the most overused, robotic hallmarks of AI-generated template kits.
- Instead: Lead with clean, distraction-free solid surfaces (`var(--ai-surface-0)`, `var(--ai-bg)`, `var(--ai-surface-1)`) structured with subtle 1px hairline architectural borders (`var(--ai-border)`).

---

## 2. The 4 Curated Design Direction Archetypes

When generating new views, assign a clear archetype rather than defaulting to generic SaaS styling:

### Archetype A: Executive Slate
- Vibe: High-density, disciplined engineering workspace, precision data tools.
- Attribute: `[data-ai-skin="executive"]`
- Typography: IBM Plex Sans with Sora headings, IBM Plex Mono metadata.
- Geometry: 4px architectural radius (`--ai-radius-base: 4px;`).
- Accents: Cool slate neutrals with #2563eb cobalt blue accent.

### Archetype B: Fintech Titanium
- Vibe: Regulated financial intelligence, institutional security, high clarity.
- Attribute: `[data-ai-skin="fintech"]`
- Typography: High-legibility DM Sans throughout.
- Geometry: 6px radius (`--ai-radius-base: 6px;`).
- Accents: Warm titanium stone neutrals with #0f766e emerald/teal accents.

### Archetype C: Obsidian Minimal
- Vibe: Pure dark-mode minimalist console, brutalist restraint, developer-first.
- Attribute: `[data-ai-skin="obsidian"]`
- Typography: Sora headings with DM Sans and IBM Plex Mono.
- Geometry: 0px to 2px sharp radii (`--ai-radius-base: 2px;`).
- Accents: Pitch-black background (#000000) with stark white (#ededed) hairline rules.

### Archetype D: Editorial Atelier
- Vibe: High-craft publication, thoughtful essay, luxury studio, timeless typography.
- Attribute: `[data-ai-skin="editorial"]`
- Typography: Newsreader serif display headlines, crisp Plus Jakarta Sans body text.
- Geometry: 3px to 4px subtle radius (`--ai-radius-base: 4px;`).
- Accents: Warm paper substrate (#faf8f5) with terracotta / bronze (#8c4a27) accent.

---

## 3. Core CSS Tokens

- Surfaces: `--ai-bg`, `--ai-surface-0`, `--ai-surface-1`, `--ai-surface-2`, `--ai-surface-3`
- Text: `--ai-text-primary`, `--ai-text-secondary`, `--ai-text-muted`, `--ai-text-inverted`
- Borders: `--ai-border`, `--ai-border-subtle`, `--ai-border-strong`, `--ai-border-hover`
- Actions: `--ai-primary`, `--ai-primary-hover`, `--ai-primary-text`, `--ai-accent`, `--ai-accent-hover`, `--ai-accent-subtle`, `--ai-accent-rgb`
- Status: `--ai-success`, `--ai-warning`, `--ai-danger`, `--ai-info`
- Accessible Chart Palette: `--ai-chart-1` through `--ai-chart-6` (color-blind safe)
- Touch Targets: `--ai-touch-min: 44px;`
- Shadows: `--ai-shadow-sm`, `--ai-shadow-md`, `--ai-shadow-lg`, `--ai-shadow-xl`
- Radii: `--ai-radius-xs` (2px), `--ai-radius-sm` (4px), `--ai-radius-md` (6px), `--ai-radius-lg` (8px), `--ai-radius-xl` (10px), `--ai-radius-full` (9999px)
- Motion: `--ai-ease-smooth`, `--ai-ease-spring` (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), `--ai-duration-fast` (150ms), `--ai-duration-normal` (250ms)

---

- **Focus ring**: `--ai-focus-color` (default: accent at 65%), `--ai-focus-width` (2px), `--ai-focus-offset` (2px) compose `--ai-focus-ring`. Presets on `<html>`: `data-ai-focus="neutral"` (text-colored ring), `"thin"` (1.5px, no offset), `"none"` (no ring; keyboard users lose the indicator, so prefer neutral or thin). Rings render only on `:focus-visible`, never on tap or click. `--ai-tap-highlight` (default transparent) controls the tint mobile browsers flash on tap.

## 4. Modern Responsive & Layout Patterns

- Container Queries (Self-Responsive Elements):
  `<div class="ai-cq ai-grid ai-cq:grid-cols-2 ai-cq:gap-4">...</div>`
- Intrinsic Auto-Fit Grids (Zero Media Queries):
  `<div class="ai-grid-auto-fit ai-grid-min-md ai-gap-4">...</div>`
- CSS Subgrid:
  `<div class="ai-subgrid-rows">...</div>`
- Touch Accessibility:
  All buttons and form controls enforce 44px minimum tap height on coarse pointers (`@media (pointer: coarse)`).
- Mobile Safari Auto-Zoom Fix:
  Form inputs maintain a minimum 16px font size on viewports under 768px to prevent iOS viewport distortion.

---

## 5. Standard Component Class Patterns

- Button: `<button class="ai-btn ai-btn-primary">Action</button>`
  - Variants: `ai-btn-secondary`, `ai-btn-outline`, `ai-btn-ghost`, `ai-btn-accent`, `ai-btn-danger`
  - Sizes: `ai-btn-xs`, `ai-btn-sm`, `ai-btn-lg`, `ai-btn-xl`, `ai-btn-icon`
  - States: `is-loading` (displays spinner without layout shift)
- Card: `<div class="ai-card"><div class="ai-card-header">...</div><div class="ai-card-body">...</div><div class="ai-card-footer">...</div></div>`
- Status Pip: `<span class="ai-status-pip ai-status-pip-success"></span>` (Steady jewel; add `.is-streaming` for active data streams)
- Form Control: `<div class="ai-form-group"><label class="ai-label is-required">Email</label><input type="email" class="ai-input" aria-invalid="false" /></div>`
- Badge: `<span class="ai-badge ai-badge-success ai-badge-dot">Online</span>`
- Modal: `<div class="ai-modal" id="my-modal"><div class="ai-modal-backdrop" data-ai-dismiss="modal"></div><div class="ai-modal-box">...</div></div>`
- Web Component Modal: `<ai-modal id="my-modal">...</ai-modal>`
- Tabs: `<div class="ai-tabs"><div class="ai-tabs-list"><button class="ai-tab is-active" data-ai-tab="#tab1">Tab 1</button>...</div></div>`

---

## 6. CLI & MCP Tooling for Autonomous Agents

- CLI Design Harness: `npx llmcss harness [archetype]`
- CLI Design Quality Audit: `npx llmcss audit <file>`
- CLI Hallucination Check: `npx llmcss validate <file>`
- CLI Hallucination Auto-Fix: `npx llmcss lint --fix <file>`
- Stdio MCP Server: `npx llmcss-mcp`
  - `llmcss_get_harness`: Returns design direction archetype tokens and prompt directives.
  - `llmcss_slop_audit`: Audits code snippets against all 10 anti-slop rules.
  - `search_components`: Search component catalog (includes 40+ design synonyms in alias map).
  - `get_component_markup`: Returns canonical HTML and CSS dependencies.
  - `validate_markup`: Validates markup against LLMCSS standards.
  - `list_tokens`: Returns token values by category.
  - `list_wireframe_templates`: List available wireframe sections with placement rules.
  - `get_wireframe_template`: Retrieve clean HTML markup and placement guidance.
  - `get_page_blueprint`: Retrieve fully assembled multi-section page recipes.

---

## 7. Wireframe Section Templates & Page Blueprints

LLMCSS provides 14 canonical wireframe section templates with explicit layout guidance, plus 4 full-page composition recipes.

### Section Templates Catalog

1. `wireframe-nav-minimal` (Header)
   - Placement: Top of Page (Above Fold, sticky or static z-index 45).
   - Guidance: Clean SaaS homepages, focused documentation hubs, and portfolios.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-hero-split`, `wireframe-hero-centered`, `wireframe-hero-editorial`.

2. `wireframe-nav-banner` (Header)
   - Placement: Top of Page (Above Fold, above or integrated with header).
   - Guidance: Developer tool launches, release updates, and conference advisories.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-hero-centered`, `wireframe-hero-split`.

3. `wireframe-hero-split` (Hero)
   - Placement: Hero Section (Above Fold, immediately after Nav).
   - Guidance: B2B SaaS homepages with interactive preview container or live dock.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-nav-minimal`, `wireframe-social-proof-bar`, `wireframe-features-bento`.

4. `wireframe-hero-centered` (Hero)
   - Placement: Hero Section (Above Fold, centered focal point).
   - Guidance: Developer tools, open-source libraries, and CLI utilities.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-nav-banner`, `wireframe-social-proof-bar`, `wireframe-features-alternating`.

5. `wireframe-hero-editorial` (Hero)
   - Placement: Hero Section (Above Fold, asymmetric narrative layout).
   - Guidance: Design studios, editorial publications, and AI research labs.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-nav-minimal`, `wireframe-social-proof-bar`, `wireframe-features-bento`.

6. `wireframe-social-proof-bar` (Social Proof)
   - Placement: Mid-Funnel Anchor (Directly below Hero section).
   - Guidance: Establishing credibility with partner logos and key telemetry metrics.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-hero-split`, `wireframe-hero-centered`, `wireframe-features-bento`.

7. `wireframe-features-bento` (Features)
   - Placement: Core Content (Mid-Funnel, below Social Proof).
   - Guidance: Multi-faceted capability highlights in a 4-cell tactile bento grid.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-social-proof-bar`, `wireframe-pricing-tiers`, `wireframe-comparison-matrix`.

8. `wireframe-features-alternating` (Features)
   - Placement: Core Content (Mid-Funnel, below Overview or Bento Grid).
   - Guidance: Deep-dive narrative walkthroughs with alternating media blocks.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-features-bento`, `wireframe-comparison-matrix`, `wireframe-pricing-tiers`.

9. `wireframe-comparison-matrix` (Comparison)
   - Placement: Pre-Pricing Proof (Mid to Bottom of Page).
   - Guidance: Tabular feature and performance comparison against incumbents.
   - Pairs With: `wireframe-features-bento`, `wireframe-pricing-tiers`, `wireframe-cta-card`.

10. `wireframe-pricing-tiers` (Pricing)
    - Placement: Conversion Stage (Lower Funnel, above FAQ).
    - Guidance: 3-tier monetary pricing grid with featured tier elevation.
    - Pairs With: `wireframe-comparison-matrix`, `wireframe-faq-accordion`, `wireframe-cta-card`.

11. `wireframe-faq-accordion` (FAQ)
    - Placement: Pre-Footer Validation (Directly below Pricing).
    - Guidance: Native details / summary accordions answering buyer questions.
    - Pairs With: `wireframe-pricing-tiers`, `wireframe-cta-card`, `wireframe-footer-columns`.

12. `wireframe-cta-card` (CTA)
    - Placement: Pre-Footer Conversion Anchor (Directly above Footer).
    - Guidance: High-contrast pre-footer card with single email capture.
    - Pairs With: `wireframe-pricing-tiers`, `wireframe-faq-accordion`, `wireframe-footer-columns`.

13. `wireframe-footer-columns` (Footer)
    - Placement: Bottom of Page (Terminal element).
    - Guidance: 4-column architectural sitemap footer with status and legal row.
    - Pairs With: `wireframe-cta-card`.

14. `wireframe-app-shell` (App Shell)
    - Placement: Application Viewport (Full Screen Root Layout).
    - Guidance: SaaS product dashboards, admin panels, and consoles.
    - Pairs With: None (standalone root shell).

### Page Blueprints / Composition Recipes

1. `saas-landing`:
   Stack: `wireframe-nav-minimal` -> `wireframe-hero-split` -> `wireframe-social-proof-bar` -> `wireframe-features-bento` -> `wireframe-pricing-tiers` -> `wireframe-faq-accordion` -> `wireframe-cta-card` -> `wireframe-footer-columns`.

2. `developer-tool`:
   Stack: `wireframe-nav-banner` -> `wireframe-hero-centered` -> `wireframe-social-proof-bar` -> `wireframe-features-alternating` -> `wireframe-comparison-matrix` -> `wireframe-cta-card` -> `wireframe-footer-columns`.

3. `editorial-manifesto`:
   Stack: `wireframe-nav-minimal` -> `wireframe-hero-editorial` -> `wireframe-social-proof-bar` -> `wireframe-features-bento` -> `wireframe-faq-accordion` -> `wireframe-cta-card` -> `wireframe-footer-columns`.

4. `dashboard-shell`:
   Stack: `wireframe-app-shell`.

---

## 4. LLMCSS Layout Utilities & Helpers (Bootstrap & Tailwind Parity)

LLMCSS includes complete layout, flexbox, grid, sizing, and content utilities in `@layer utilities`:

### 12-Column Grid System & Spanning
- Grid containers: `.ai-grid`, `.ai-inline-grid`, `.ai-grid-cols-1` through `.ai-grid-cols-12`
- Column spans: `.ai-col-auto`, `.ai-col-span-1` through `.ai-col-span-12`, `.ai-col-span-full`
- Column placement: `.ai-col-start-1` through `.ai-col-start-13`, `.ai-col-end-1` through `.ai-col-end-13`
- Row spans & templates: `.ai-grid-rows-1` through `.ai-grid-rows-6`, `.ai-row-span-1` through `.ai-row-span-6`, `.ai-row-span-full`, `.ai-row-auto`
- Grid auto-flow: `.ai-grid-flow-row`, `.ai-grid-flow-col`, `.ai-grid-flow-dense`
- Intrinsic auto-fit grid: `.ai-grid-auto-fit` with min-width modifiers `.ai-grid-min-xs` (160px), `.ai-grid-min-sm` (220px), `.ai-grid-min-md` (280px), `.ai-grid-min-lg` (340px)
- Native subgrid: `.ai-subgrid-rows`, `.ai-subgrid-cols`

### Spacing System (Token-Backed)
Scale: 0 (0px), 1 (4px), 2 (8px), 3 (12px), 4 (16px), 5 (20px), 6 (24px), 8 (32px), 10 (40px), 12 (48px), 16 (64px), 20 (80px), 24 (96px), 32 (128px)
- Padding: `.ai-p-{n}`, `.ai-px-{n}`, `.ai-py-{n}`, `.ai-pt-{n}`, `.ai-pb-{n}`, `.ai-pl-{n}`, `.ai-pr-{n}`
- Margin: `.ai-m-{n}`, `.ai-mx-{n}`, `.ai-my-{n}`, `.ai-mt-{n}`, `.ai-mb-{n}`, `.ai-ml-{n}`, `.ai-mr-{n}`
- Auto margins: `.ai-m-auto`, `.ai-mx-auto`, `.ai-my-auto`, `.ai-mt-auto`, `.ai-mb-auto`, `.ai-ml-auto`, `.ai-mr-auto`
- Negative margins: `.ai--m-{n}`, `.ai--mx-{n}`, `.ai--my-{n}`, `.ai--mt-{n}`, `.ai--mb-{n}` for values 1 to 4

### Flexbox Alignment & Layout
- Direction: `.ai-flex-row`, `.ai-flex-row-reverse`, `.ai-flex-col`, `.ai-flex-col-reverse`
- Wrap: `.ai-flex-wrap`, `.ai-flex-wrap-reverse`, `.ai-flex-nowrap`
- Sizing: `.ai-flex-1`, `.ai-flex-auto`, `.ai-flex-initial`, `.ai-flex-none`, `.ai-grow`, `.ai-grow-0`, `.ai-shrink`, `.ai-shrink-0`
- Alignment: `.ai-items-start`, `.ai-items-center`, `.ai-items-end`, `.ai-items-baseline`, `.ai-items-stretch`
- Justification: `.ai-justify-start`, `.ai-justify-center`, `.ai-justify-end`, `.ai-justify-between`, `.ai-justify-around`, `.ai-justify-evenly`
- Self-alignment: `.ai-self-auto`, `.ai-self-start`, `.ai-self-center`, `.ai-self-end`, `.ai-self-stretch`
- Order: `.ai-order-first`, `.ai-order-last`, `.ai-order-none`, `.ai-order-1` through `.ai-order-12`

### Sizing & Position Coordinates
- Width: `.ai-w-auto`, `.ai-w-full`, `.ai-w-screen`, `.ai-w-fit`, `.ai-w-1/2`, `.ai-w-1/3`, `.ai-w-2/3`, `.ai-w-1/4`, `.ai-w-3/4`
- Max & min width: `.ai-min-w-0`, `.ai-min-w-full`, `.ai-max-w-xs` through `.ai-max-w-6xl`, `.ai-max-w-prose` (65ch), `.ai-max-w-full`
- Height: `.ai-h-auto`, `.ai-h-full`, `.ai-h-screen`, `.ai-min-h-0`, `.ai-min-h-full`, `.ai-min-h-screen`
- Position: `.ai-static`, `.ai-fixed`, `.ai-absolute`, `.ai-relative`, `.ai-sticky`
- Insets: `.ai-inset-0`, `.ai-inset-auto`, `.ai-inset-x-0`, `.ai-inset-y-0`, `.ai-top-0`, `.ai-bottom-0`, `.ai-left-0`, `.ai-right-0`
- Absolute Centering: `.ai-translate-center`, `.ai-translate-x-center`, `.ai-translate-y-center`
- Layering: `.ai-z-0`, `.ai-z-10`, `.ai-z-20`, `.ai-z-30`, `.ai-z-40`, `.ai-z-50`, `.ai-z-auto`

### Content & Display Helpers
- Aspect ratio: `.ai-aspect-square` (1:1), `.ai-aspect-video` (16:9), `.ai-aspect-auto`
- Object fit: `.ai-object-contain`, `.ai-object-cover`, `.ai-object-fill`, `.ai-object-scale-down`
- Truncation & clamp: `.ai-truncate`, `.ai-line-clamp-1`, `.ai-line-clamp-2`, `.ai-line-clamp-3`
- Interactivity: `.ai-pointer-events-none`, `.ai-pointer-events-auto`, `.ai-select-none`, `.ai-select-text`
- Accessibility: `.ai-sr-only`, `.ai-not-sr-only`

### Responsive & Container Queries
- Breakpoints: `ai-sm:` (640px), `ai-md:` (768px), `ai-lg:` (1024px), `ai-xl:` (1280px)
- Container query variants: `.ai-cq` container host with `ai-cq:grid-cols-*`, `ai-cq:col-span-*`, `ai-cq:flex-row`, `ai-cq:gap-*`
